note: Literal same-edition composites preserve each proper and its own full rubric formula/Amen. Printed cues are retained in headers and not duplicated as words. RG115a+e is an explicit rubric insertion only for the Philip Neri Secret. All selected stress, punctuation and case departures are positioned below; no performance or parent-assembly approval follows.

adjudicated.ruling: Retain Dóminum with stress controlled by same-edition Benziger p.123 / n202 matching common formula words. Its literal RG115a list prints Dominum without that stress; no accent is inserted into the witness.
Retain Christum without the following comma, as in Benziger RG115a and its local Philip Neri Secret cue where present. Vatican has Christum,; both settings retain their literal punctuation.

Retain Fílium with stress controlled by same-edition Benziger p.123 / n202 matching common formula words. Its literal RG115a list prints Filium without that stress; no accent is inserted into the witness.

Retain tuum: as in the accented Benziger common formula on p.123 / n202. The local Philip Neri Secret cues at Benziger p.539 and Vatican p.536 also print this colon. Both literal RG115a lists print tuum, and remain unchanged in the composite witnesses.

Retain capital Qui following the selected colon, as in Benziger p.123 / n202. The local Philip Neri Secret cues at Benziger p.539 and Vatican p.536 also print Qui. Both literal RG115a lists print lowercase qui; this is not an accent-only difference.

Retain unitáte with stress controlled by same-edition Benziger p.123 / n202 matching common formula words. Its literal RG115a list prints unitate without that stress; no accent is inserted into the witness.

Retain eiúsdem as directly printed in the local Benziger Philip Neri Secret cue at p.539 / n620 and Vatican local cue and RG115e. Same-edition RG115e requires eiusdem after unitate. The unaccented Benziger rubric reading remains eiusdem; B202 is not its accent authority.

Retain Spíritus with stress controlled by same-edition Benziger p.123 / n202 matching common formula words. Its literal RG115a list prints Spiritus without that stress; no accent is inserted into the witness.
Retain ómnia with stress controlled by same-edition Benziger p.226 / n305 terminal. Its literal RG115a list prints omnia without that stress; no accent is inserted into the witness.
Retain sǽcula with stress controlled by same-edition Benziger p.226 / n305 terminal. Its literal RG115a list prints sæcula without that stress; no accent is inserted into the witness.
Retain sæculórum. with stress controlled by same-edition Benziger p.226 / n305 terminal. Its literal RG115a list prints sæculorum. without that stress; no accent is inserted into the witness.
Retain the separate Amen response period attested by Benziger p.226 / n305. Both RG115a lists use a semicolon as list punctuation; their literal composite readings remain Amen;.
